description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Notify the removal of Chairman and members of the Director Board of Sabaragamuwa Province Road Passenger Transport Authority
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the removal of specific named individuals (Mr. R. D. C. Jayawardene, Mr. D. P. A. Palitha Wickramasinghe, etc.) from their positions (Chairman/Director) without describing any of their portfolio responsibilities or detailing the functions of the authority. It is purely a personnel change announcement, fitting the definition of a People Gazette.
